subject.title: fix(tui): keep chat history in order; persist local shell commands to history

question: Should ordinary TUI `!` command output be persisted and included in model context by default, or must model-visible sharing remain explicit?
rationale: The current user contract describes local execution, while this PR silently moves potentially sensitive terminal data into persistent provider-visible context; code review cannot choose that product and security boundary.

options.title: Require explicit sharing
options.body: Keep ordinary `!` execution local-only and add a distinct, discoverable action or syntax for persisting output into model context.

options.title: Persist history-only
options.body: Save local commands for session resume but exclude them from model context unless the user separately shares them.

options.title: Approve `!` and `!!` semantics
options.body: Adopt `!` as model-visible and `!!` as history-only only with in-product help, documentation, redaction guidance, and upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Require explicit sharing
recommendation.body: Keep ordinary `!` execution local-only and add a distinct, discoverable action or syntax for persisting output into model context.

likelyOwner.reason: The local-shell consent implementation is the closest historical decision point for extending what consent covers.
